title: Identifying Epithelial-Cell Progression Signatures (ECPSs) from Multi-Resolution Multi-Omics Data for Translational Clinical Applications in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
snippet: Dynamic transcriptomic remodeling of epithelial cells represents a critical hallmark of lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) progression, yet epithelial-cell progression signatures (ECPSs) linked to this process remain incompletely characterized, impeding our understanding of malignant LUAD transformation. title: Phylogeography of Bone Metastasis: Clonal Evolution, Skeletal Niche Adaptation, and Clinical Implications.
